segments.text: AI agents that need to work in real business environments eventually hit the wall of proprietary Office formats.
Office CLI is a single binary CLI written in C that lets agents read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files natively from the
terminal. generate spreadsheets, rewrite contracts, scrape data from pitch decks, all without Microsoft Office installed on the host
